claims: The Pentagon's FY 2027 budget request proposes buying 85 F-35 fighter jets.
47 F-35 fighter jets were requested in the Pentagon's FY 2026 budget.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 F-35 budget request includes 38 F-35A for the Air Force.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 F-35 budget request includes 37 F-35C for the Navy.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 F-35 budget request includes 10 F-35B for the Marine Corps.
32 F-35 jets are funded via the base budget in the Pentagon's FY 2027 budget request.
53 F-35 jets are funded via a $350 billion reconciliation package in the Pentagon's FY 2027 budget request.
The total requested in the Pentagon's FY 2027 F-35 budget is 85 Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II aircraft.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 F-35 budget request represents an 81% increase in procurement over the FY 2026 request of 47 jets.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 budget proposes a $1.15 trillion base defense budget.
The Pentagon's FY 2027 budget proposes $350 billion in additional funding.
The 85-jet F-35 procurement is part of a broader $1.5 trillion total defense proposal.
